articles.title: US Fed chairman Kevin Warsh says inflation is elevated and 'concerning' at Jackson Hole
articles.content: US Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said on Friday that high inflation in the world's largest economy was "concerning," as he opened a key central bankers' meeting in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. Warsh, who has been reticent to share his views on the economy since he took office, said that the central bank's "predominant focus right now should be on prices."

articles.title: US stocks today: US stocks open subdued ahead of Warsh's speech
articles.content: Wall Street opened mostly flat on Friday as the AI-driven rally lost momentum ahead of Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech. articles.title: Quote of the day by Arnold Van Den Berg: "Regardless of yield, when investments are absent of value, cash is always a better option than permanently losing money"
articles.content: Arnold Van Den Berg’s investing wisdom stresses that yield alone does not make an investment attractive. When value is absent and permanent capital loss risk is high, holding cash may be wiser, allowing investors to protect capital and wait for better opportunities.

articles.title: Was Sensex’s 2,000-point expiry crash a one-off? Here's what Friday's close hints about CAS
articles.content: Sensex stayed relatively calm during Friday’s closing auction, a day after a 2,000-point plunge during the monthly expiry raised fresh concerns over CAS. The subdued move suggests Thursday’s sharp swings may have been an expiry-driven anomaly rather than a persistent issue with the new closing-price mechanism, experts said.

articles.title: Global Markets: BYD posts first quarterly profit rise in over a year
articles.content: Chinese automaker BYD has experienced its first profit growth in over a year, primarily fueled by a sharp increase in export sales. This international expansion effectively balanced out the lackluster results seen domestically. In the second quarter, BYD reported a remarkable year-on-year net profit increase of 29.8 percent, although revenue faced a slight decline of 3.2 percent during the same timeframe.

articles.title: Rupee gains this week as dollar supply surges ahead of deposit window's close
articles.content: The Indian rupee managed to finish higher on Friday, achieving a weekly upswing bolstered by a jump in dollar liquidity as a special deposit facility approaches its end. Early drops were countered by inflows that led to position unwind. Although month-end importer needs put pressure on the rupee, advantageous flows due to MSCI rebalancing offered relief.

articles.title: SBI General Insurance Q1 GDPI rises to Rs 3,506 crore; comprehensive income jumps 17%

articles.title: CAS chaos: How did Sensex crash 2,000 points in 6 minutes while Nifty stayed stable on monthly expiry?
articles.content: Sensex plunged over 2,000 points during Thursday’s closing auction session before recovering some losses, while Nifty remained comparatively stable. Market experts attributed the sharp divergence largely to thin trading volumes on BSE. The episode has renewed scrutiny of the new CAS mechanism, particularly around monthly expiry and its impact on price discovery.

articles.title: Global Market: German bond yields rise as investors weigh inflation risks and ECB rate path
articles.content: German bond yields moved higher as investors weighed persistent inflation risks and expectations for the European Central Bank’s interest-rate path. Short-dated yields remained under pressure, while longer-dated yields also edged up. Investors also watched French and Italian bond spreads and awaited Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech for clues on global monetary policy.

articles.title: India can reach a $5.1 trillion economy by FY29 as growth strengthens: Omniscience Capital
articles.content: India's economy could reach $5.1 trillion by FY29, according to OmniScience Capital. Stronger real growth and healthier balance sheets support this expansion. The pandemic and rupee depreciation had previously delayed this $5 trillion ambition. Real GDP growth averaged 7.4% between FY22 and FY26. An optimistic scenario projects India's GDP reaching $5.9 trillion by FY29.

articles.title: Global Market: Shein’s Hong Kong debut marks a major shift towards its Chinese roots
articles.content: Shein is set to debut in Hong Kong, marking a shift toward embracing its Chinese roots after failed US and UK listing efforts. Regulatory approval, strong manufacturing and supply-chain ties, and domestic economic contributions helped secure the listing. The IPO highlights growing geopolitical pressures and Shein’s sharply reduced valuation.
